items.item_text: Three years of experience in food preparation and general maintenance of a kitchen area; or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Experience to taste and discern product quality, read and interpret recipes and menus, estimate ingredient requirements, check production and keep records to accurately plan production requirements and request supplies and equipment.
Culinary experience and/or equivalent training in a high-volume, fast-paced food production environment to read, interpret, and deliver food product based on customer orders.
Experience with culinary techniques, including but not limited to: sautéing, grilling, frying, steaming, and preparing sauces and stocks.
Experience providing excellent customer service in a fast-paced food service environment.
Experience to maintain a sanitary, safe and organized personal work area.

Reporting to the unit Chef and Sous Chefs, cook and serve all food assigned on time and to standards of excellent taste, quality and appearance. Prepare food from scratch including entrees, starches, vegetables, gravies and sauces, soups, breads, desserts, etc. Work independently preparing entrees and following recipes and menus and batch cooking guidelines without direction. In consultation with senior cook and/or sous chef taste and discern product quality, read and interpret recipes and menus, estimate ingredient requirements, check production and keep records to accurately plan production requirements and request supplies and equipment. Monitor cost control by using professional cooking techniques, recognizing safety, budget and quality factors and tracking food usage using daily report. Maintain unit standards for product quality, service, cleanliness, communication, training and work order flow. Prepare menus for special events or meals. Collaborate food preparation and service duties to kitchen support staff and cooks. Provide coaching to student assistant staff. Continuously monitor and receive customer orders, read tickets, monitor ticket times, communicate when assistance is needed for timely completion of orders. Receive and review incoming shipments. Confirm quality and safety of product. Properly store product in storage, coolers, and freezers, following proper food safety guidelines. Perform accurate product inventories. Successful completion of Sanitation/Food Borne Illness prevention (HACCP) and annual renewal. Keep work area clean and debris free. Identify, communicate, and correct hazards. Set-up/clean equipment, work tables, sinks and drains at beginning and end of shift. Perform full range of kitchen cleaning and facility sanitation, using appropriate chemicals. Ensure proper and safe use of chemicals per SDS information and correct use of personal protective equipment (PPE). Independently safely use, assemble, disassemble, and train others to use kitchen equipment. Use hand tools, sweep, mop, dust, polish silverware, and wash pots, pans, dishes, and equipment. Minimize and eliminate waste by effective use of resources. Sort waste for recycling and pre/post-consumer composting. Maintain security of Unit equipment and supplies. Demonstrate professionalism, enthusiasm and integrity with all internal and external customers. Convey welcoming attitude by actively engaging and greeting customers during all periods of service. Anticipate customer needs. Display a positive demeanor. Ensure positive guest experience by accommodating special requests and making suggestions. Participate in production and unit/departmental meetings.
Skill to prepare complex recipes and perform multiple tasks simultaneously.
Arithmetic skills to increase or decrease recipe yields and to convert standard culinary measurements.
Knowledge of cuisines from varying customer bases, including Regional American, Asian, Italian and Mexican, Vegetarian, Vegan.
Knowledge of UC policies and procedures.
Skills to communicate in English, both orally and in written form to understand and carry out oral and written instructions and interact effectively with co-workers, supervisors and guests.
Interpersonal skills to work effectively with and provide excellent customer service to a diverse campus community; communication skills to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships.
